title: Audit Trail & Accountability System
summary: Define autonomy levels by risk, implement human-in-the-loop workflows, enforce least-privilege access, block policy violations, and design complete accountability systems.

rows: Tamper-evident proof commits were made by the agent
Links AI-generated code to the human who initiated the task
Full record of agent reasoning, tool calls, and decisions per session
Every commit links to its session log for code review and audit
Admin-viewable log of all agentic activity in org/enterprise

blocks.text: **Exam Tip:** All five artifact types together = complete accountability. Expect questions asking which combination satisfies a compliance audit requirement.
